steps.instruction: Click the Sculpting tab at the top of the window.
steps.spoken: Look at the tabs at the top. Click Sculpting.
steps.why: A workspace is a ready-made desk layout for one kind of job.
steps.hint_if_stuck: The tabs run across the top, between Modeling and UV Editing.

steps.spoken: Now click Shading. This desk is set up for materials and colour.
steps.why: Switching workspace changes the screen layout, not your scene.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Shading is a few tabs to the right of Texture Paint.

steps.instruction: Click the Layout tab to come back.
steps.spoken: Last one. Click Layout to come back to the normal view.
steps.why: Layout is the home desk where most beginners work.
steps.hint_if_stuck: Layout is the first tab on the left of the top bar.
